title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the La Paz Elementary School, Laoag City, to Eulalio F. Siazon Memorial Elementary School

text.en: The name of the La Paz Elementary School situated in Barangay La Paz, Laoag City, is hereby changed to Eulalio F. Siazon Memorial Elementary School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports is hereby directed to promulgate and issue rules for the implementation of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
